- Redwood’s current practice: we notify affected customers as soon as we confirm an incident impacting customer data; our target initial notification window is within 24 hours of confirmation and a follow-up incident report within 72 hours.
- We maintain a formal IR playbook and post-incident root cause reports; we can provide a redacted runbook and a sample incident report under an NDA.

4) BCP / DR
- High-level BCP/DR overview attached (BCP-DR-Overview.pdf). Typical RTO/RPO depend on customer SLA tier; we can provide environment-specific RTO/RPO during a security walkthrough.
